units.about: round settings for the two detectors, chosen for the poster; scripts/xrd-maps.mjs reads the flat plate's for its simulated maps
units.chi: tilt from flat; 0 means the sample lies flat in the beam
units.omegaDeg: the turn the frame records: the strip's at the start of its scan, the plate's at the end of its; both scans turn the sample at half the arm's rate
units.twoThetaStartDeg: the arm's angle at the start of the frame's scan
units.twoThetaCentreDeg: the middle of the frame's scan, where the machine's arm points
units.twoThetaEndDeg: the arm's angle at the end of the frame's scan
units.columns: each frame column is one step of the arm's scan, columnDeg wide
